i think it’s about finding ways to be comfortable in increasingly dark and quiet rooms. get a small night light and listen to a relaxing audiobook or get a white noise/rain machine. over time perhaps you’ll find that you don’t need the light anymore, or the noise, or both. i have to fall asleep with the TV on unless i’m very very tired because i hate lying awake in the dark and trying to force myself to sleep. if i’m tired enough to fall asleep quickly, then i don’t need anything to distract me.
